## Burning Springs: Fishing

The Burning Springs update introduces 4 new fish to catch! IMPORTANT NOTE ABOUT SANDSTORMS If you are trying to catch a specific fish, such as a Local Legend or a Glowing Fish, Sandstorms are treated as Clear (No) Weather for spawn checks. If you are completing Fish in a Sandstorm challenges, the game performs a separate condition check to confirm that either a weather station sandstorm or a natural sandstorm is active.
